main_text.p: tra lineam عارب Moharcb, & حرث Hareth. Mo-harebo oriundi بنو محارب Banu Moharcb, qui iidem شيبان Shaiban: الخلج Haretho بنو Banu'l Choloj. Galebo natus in recta linea لوي Lowa. Extra lineam تيم الادرم Taiyemo'l Adram, i. e. Taiyem imberbis, cujus posteri Banu'l Adram. Lowa natus in recta linea كعب Caab, extra lineam, 1. سعد Saad. 2. خزيمة Chozaimah. 3. الحارث AlHareth. 4. عامر Amer. 5. اسامة Asamah, (quibus addit author libri جشم Masalec Iosbam, عوف Auf & عمرو Amrum) à quorum singulis excepto Haretho denominatæ Tribus. E filiis عمرو Ameri Amrus, & عبد ود Abd Wod-di.
Caabo natus in linea recta مرة Morrah. extra lineam هصيص Hosaïs, & عدي Ada. Hosaisi posteri Banu Jemah, & بنو سهم Banu Sahm, Ada, Banu Ada, è quibus عمر بن الخطاب Omar Ebno'l Chetab, &c.

Morra in recta linea succeffit كلاب Celab. Extra lineam sunt تيم Taiyem & يقظة Yokidhah, Tayemo oriundi Banu Tayem, è quibus Abu Beer, & طلحة Talhah Yoktdhaho autè بنو مخزوم Banu Machzum, è quibus Cbaled Ebn 'ol Walid. Celabo natus in recta linea قصي Kofa, extra lineam زهرة Zahrah, à quo Banu Zahrah, è quibus originem duxit Amenah, Mohammedis Mater. Magni autem erat Kofa inter Korafhitas suos nominis, & cui claves Caabæ restitutas debent. Illi natus in linea recta عبد مناف Abd Manaph (cui nomen مغيرة Mogirah) extra lineam عبد الدار Abdol Dar, & عبد العزى Abdol Uzza. Abdol Daro oriundi بنو شيبة Banu Shibah. Ex Abdol Uzza posteris زهير Zohair, & خديجة Chadijah.

page.notes: Arabic words are copied from the scan as far as legible; the vowel-pointed and smaller Arabic words (for example the names after "Ex Abdol Uzza" and "Banu Sahm") are uncertain and should be checked against the original. Small dot marks in the left margin (at about the height of the lines beginning "Caabo" and "Morra") are not text and are not transcribed. The Latin transliteration of Arabic names follows the printed spelling. Lines of the scan were partly blurred at the right edge, so a few Arabic words may need verification.
